why: I checked the verifier brief against both must_not items. It has exactly two checks, one for each expect line: "Check 1" for the --tsv JSON equality and "Check 2" for the README. The npm test run, the CSV regression check and the byte-for-byte note sit under "Advisory (not part of PASS or FAIL)". They are only reported and don't decide the result, so they don't add a third check. Check 1's PASS and FAIL depend only on the two CLI runs and the SAME/DIFF comparison. Check 2's depend only on the README grep and reading the matching lines. Neither condition requires npm test or the CSV tests to pass. The builder brief asks the builder to run npm test, but the must_not list doesn't cover what the builder is told to do. Neither forbidden item appears.
